regions.name: CUADRE-RENDER
restore: // READINESS GATE (plan §5): never compute cash before the orders feed AND the cutover config have loaded,
// and never without a valid shift identity. Show "cargando…" instead of a false L0; the subscriptions
// re-call showCuadre as they arrive. A loaded-but-identity-less shift (legacy, pre-2.5.0) is a distinct,
// explicit state — not cargando — because it will not resolve on its own.
// §6/BC1: continuous readiness gate. Hold "cargando" while the feed is not ready (initial load OR a reconnect
// re-sync) OR the cutover config has not loaded OR a pending-handoff order is awaiting its fresh history
// reconcile — a just-delivered order mid-handoff must never let the cuadre undercount.
// No valid shift identity (e.g. a shift active across the 2.5.0 upgrade with no current_shift_id). The core
// cuadre needs a shift id to record under; the driver ends + restarts the shift so the next close records
// correctly. (The emergency close for an unidentified shift is a separate future slice.)
renderCuadreReceipt({ uid: currentUser.uid, shiftId: ident.shiftId, start: ident.start });
// THE single source for the receipt: compute the cash from the CURRENT settled orders, render it,
// and stash it on the screen as `_cash` + `_bound`. The confirm/escape actions submit screen._cash — so what is
// DISPLAYED is exactly what is SUBMITTED, every render. Returns the computed cash.
const cash = computeShiftCash(allOrders, bound.uid, bound.start, driverIdentityCutoverMs);

? `
Entregas por confirmar${cash.legacy_provisional_count + cash.unresolved_count}

Algunas entregas aún no están confirmadas por el servidor; el cuadre se marcará como provisional.
`

${cash.paidOnlineTotal > 0 ? `
Pagado en líneaL ${cash.paidOnlineTotal.toLocaleString('es-HN')}
` : ''}
Mostrá esta pantalla a quien recibe el efectivo.

regions.name: CUADRE-SUBMIT
restore: if (b) { b.disabled = false; b.textContent = 'Confirmar entrega de efectivo'; }
// Cuadre screen: Volver cancels, Confirmar records a SERVER-ACKED cuadre THEN ends the shift.
// Volver — and backing out supersedes any in-flight close so a late ack can't finalize a shift the driver
// Re-validate identity now; bind the whole operation to it.
toast('El turno cambió — volvé a abrir el cierre', 'error');
const bound = { uid: currentUser.uid, shiftId: ident.shiftId, start: ident.start };
// A fresh generation supersedes any still-in-flight prior attempt immediately (exactly-once finalize).
closeInFlight = true;   // block surface refresh for the whole operation (incl. the settle wait below)
// P1-2: wait (bounded) for any in-flight completeTask writes to SETTLE before computing. A completion can
// optimistically stamp an order locally then be REJECTED server-side (e.g. reassigned); its rejection rolls
// back the optimistic order, so recomputing from allOrders only AFTER settlement can't bank rejected cash.
if (!isLatest()) return;                                   // superseded by a newer confirm while waiting (it owns closeInFlight)
if (!settled) { closeInFlight = false; toast(BLOCKED_CLOSE_TEXT, 'error'); refreshOpenCashSurfaces(); return; }   // P2-6 catch-up; retry stays available (confirm re-rendered)
// P1-3: the shift may have changed while we waited — re-validate before touching money.
if (!identityMatches(bound)) { closeInFlight = false; toast('El turno cambió — volvé a abrir el cierre', 'error'); $('cuadre-screen').classList.remove('open'); return; }
// §6/BC1: re-check COMBINED feed readiness at confirm time. If the feed re-synced (a reconnect dropped it to
// loading) or a just-delivered order is mid-handoff, the receipt could undercount — do NOT finalize; stay on
// shift, re-render (→ "cargando"), and leave retry available.
toast('Un momento — actualizando el resumen del turno…', '');
// RECOMPUTE + REDISPLAY together from the now-settled orders (codex r3 E): renderCuadreReceipt rewrites the
// receipt AND stashes screen._cash, and we submit that exact value — so what is DISPLAYED is what is SUBMITTED
// (a completion rollback during the settle wait can't leave the shown amount ahead of the recorded one).
const btn2 = $('cuadre-confirm'); if (btn2) { btn2.disabled = true; btn2.textContent = 'Guardando…'; }   // re-render replaced the button
// ONE authoritative closing operation. Its outcome — whether it acks in-time or LATE (after the UI timeout)
// — is handled exactly once, HERE, and only while this attempt is still the latest (not superseded by a
// retry) AND the bound identity still holds. finalize runs under shiftBusy so the (briefly re-exposed)
// start toggle can't interleave a clock-in mid-clock-out.
const p = XPD.recordCuadre(bound.uid, bound.shiftId, { ...cash, close_op_id: closeOpId });
if (!isLatest()) return;                                   // a newer attempt owns the close now
if (!identityMatches(bound)) { toast('El turno cambió — no se cerró el turno.', 'error'); reEnableConfirm(); return; }
await finalizeEndShift();                 // ordinary clock-out via the existing endDriverShift callable
// Server REJECTED (permission/validation/other) — never clock out; the cuadre is the whole point. Stay on
// shift and surface it (this also surfaces a LATE rejection after the timeout message); the driver retries.
toast(BLOCKED_CLOSE_TEXT, 'error');        // retry stays available (button re-enabled below); dispatch is the exit
refreshOpenCashSurfaces();                 // re-render from settled orders so a retry submits the current amount
// UI-only: if no ack within the window, tell the driver to retry. We do NOT finalize or discard the op here
// — the observer above still owns its late outcome (unless a retry supersedes it).
const raced = await Promise.race([p.then(() => 'acked', () => 'failed'), new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r('timeout'), CUADRE_ACK_TIMEOUT_MS))]);
toast(BLOCKED_CLOSE_TEXT, 'error');   // no ack yet; retry stays available, dispatch is the exit; a late ack of THIS op still finalizes via the observer
